userGoal: Implement swap-jump as a real movement weapon: the thrown sphere follows normal teleport projectile physics, moves the owner to its landing point, and when an enemy is within the exchange radius moves that closest enemy to the owner's throw-time position.
inScope: normal teleport landing and enemy exchange selection
outOfScope: turn-transfer, grounder, force-field and other blocked weapons
completionCriteria: swap-jump is usable through the public TryFire path
without a nearby enemy only the owner is repositioned
with a nearby enemy the owner lands at the sphere and the closest enemy lands at the captured throw origin
the exchange does not use the owner's post-teleport position as the enemy destination
the in-flight projectile resolves to teleport_5_10_A art
